create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with weights
create_scalar_graph: create a scalar graph from a single weight value using gtn.scalar_graph
test_graph_arithmetic_ops: test gtn.add, gtn.subtract, and gtn.negate operations on graph objects
run_backward_autograd: run gtn.backward on a graph result to compute gradients with optional retain_graph
test_graph_comparison_and_io: test gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic comparisons and gtn.save gtn.load file I/O
